picks.what: Moskovskaya Street and the Ascension Cathedral, postcard
picks.why: labeled Simbirsk postcard; the Ascension Cathedral, the city’s main church (demolished 1936), on its main street; caption trimmed

picks.what: View over the city center toward the Volga, aerial photograph
picks.who: Krasnoyarsk National and Cultural Autonomy of the Chuvash People
picks.why: recent aerial view of the center along Radishchev Street with the frozen Volga behind

gaps: P0–P2: nothing (#1 is a late-19th-century illustration of the 1670 battle); P5: only single buildings (1917 zemstvo house, almshouse), a Volga pier view and 1921 posters; the 1910 view covers it
notes: #4 shows the same cathedral closer and sharper but is dated only 1900–17; #5 is dated 1910. #8 (Volga opposite Simbirsk, 1917) skipped: mostly pier sheds, and only 7 years after #5. #12 date is the Flickr date; the ice on the Volga suggests early spring 2020.
